text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: *pant*... haa...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The highly anticipated first leg of the 
Tiara route! The winner of this fiercely 
contested Oka Sho is—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The much-watched member of the 'Splendid 
Clan,' Daiichi Ruby, could not claim 
victory across two generations!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I lost. I actually lost... In such an 
important race to prove my worth.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Even though everyone placed their hopes 
on me. Even though they gave me the chance 
to stand on this stage.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Daiichi Ruby lost, huh? And here I 
was sure she was gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! Luck just wasn't on our side 
today. The blood of the 'Noble Family' is 
the real deal—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the Oaks... The race her 
mother lost. She must be burning with a 
sense of duty.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby is the true Queen of the 
Oaks! Next time, she'll show us a victory 
worthy of her name!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, there are still... things I 
have to do.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Next time... next time for sure. I will 
secure victory.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(On the supreme stage, I shall run with 
brilliance and claim the ultimate 
radiance... victory.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I came this far with that resolve. 
Therefore, this time, I must achieve 
victory no matter what.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(That is my mission... the bare minimum 
qualification. If I have time to be 
disappointed in myself――)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I must get on with the next preparations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: As soon as possible—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Whoaaa~~!! Milady, that was SO COOOOOL!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Palm-chin! Isn't this crazy?? Isn't 
this way too crazy??

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, even though I lost... she was really 
cool.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, crazy luvly...☆ I wanna run 
together real soon, ya know~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah... together, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Cryptic much?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"What is it, what is it!? Wait... this 
isn't something fun, is it!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, like, Helios runs sprint races, 
right? While Ruby will probably go for 
medium distance, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Our routes don't overlap, so... maybe we 
can't run together...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' reaaaaal!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Really!? You're medium distance, Milady!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the Oaks coming up is 2,400 
meters, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's true! It's so looong...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Oh well! Guess I'll just mingle 
casually!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Milady~~! Luuuuv yaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why do you like Ruby so much 
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be my gut feeling! I'm all about 
vibes, y'know~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oho~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah!! Being cryptic again!? What is it~~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing? Just thinking about how much 
I'm looking forward to what's ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! Seriously so true!!!!

After the race, even though victory had 
narrowly slipped through her fingers... 
Daiichi Ruby kept her usual cool 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What's done is done.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I'll switch gears and move forward to the 
Oaks.

"The Oaks"... the second leg of the Tiara 
route, a GⅠ race held at Tokyo Racecourse. 
If there's one thing different from past 
goals—

Since both her debut race and the Oka Sho 
were miles, she has focused her training 
on sprinting.

Therefore, her true ability at medium 
distances and beyond still remains 
somewhat an unknown quantity.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your concern is entirely reasonable. It 
is, after all, a distance you are not very 
accustomed to.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My mother, too, suffered a heartbreaking 
defeat in this race.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, the assessment is that distance 
wasn't the issue, but rather the heavy 
track condition affecting the outcome.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'm fine as well...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, even if an issue arises, all we need 
to do is resolve it swiftly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Please, give me your most thorough 
guidance."

And so, our days of training began anew, 
aimed toward the next target race: the 
Japanese Oaks.
